review_definition: Reviewed v1 means all ten investigation lanes were systematically checked. It does not mean the organisation is fully mapped or that every lane has a verified finding.

organisations.name: Premium Food Group / Tönnies
organisations.why: Seed case with named farm relationships, facilities, public-money participation and direct lobbying records.
organisations.what_we_know: 25+ claims across supply chain, facilities, money, competition and influence; the exact named-farm → slaughterhouse hop remains open.
organisations.next_action: Prove one exact named-farm slaughterhouse destination or publish the access boundary.

organisations.name: Westfleisch SCE mbH
organisations.why: Large farmer-owned meat group with a documented cooperative supplier network, five meat centres and group logistics.
organisations.what_we_know: All ten lanes reviewed; supplier model, legal facility operators, logistics and association links are source-backed.
organisations.next_action: Prove one named farm → named Westfleisch facility relationship and one downstream product/customer edge.

organisations.name: PHW-Gruppe / WIESENHOF
organisations.why: Vertically integrated poultry system spanning parent flocks, hatcheries, feed, contract farms, slaughter, processing and brands.
organisations.what_we_know: All ten lanes reviewed; integration, brands, broad sales channels and direct Lobbyregister activity are source-backed.
organisations.next_action: Resolve one named contract farmer → named slaughter facility and the principal German facility legal operators.

organisations.name: Danish Crown Germany
organisations.why: Current German slaughter/factory network includes Essen/Oldenburg, Husum and Teterow under named legal entities.
organisations.seed_fact: Danish Crown publicly lists German factories and slaughterhouses including Danish Crown Fleisch GmbH and Danish Crown Teterower Fleisch GmbH.
organisations.next_action: Resolve current German legal entities, facilities, farmer/supplier model, brands and post-2023 restructuring.

organisations.name: Müller Gruppe
organisations.why: Major southern German meat group with unusually explicit company-reported annual slaughter volumes.
organisations.seed_fact: The group reports more than 320,000 cattle and 2.1 million pigs slaughtered, cut and marketed annually across its sites.
organisations.next_action: Resolve each legal entity/site, supplier relationships, customers, lobbying, public money and regulatory history.

organisations.name: Plukon Germany
organisations.why: Strong chain candidate: German hatcheries, slaughter plants, processing, agricultural coordination and consumer brands.
organisations.seed_fact: Plukon reports seven German operations: three slaughter plants, two processing plants and two hatcheries, plus brands Stolle, Friki and FairMast.
organisations.next_action: Map agricultural partners → hatchery/rearing → exact slaughter site → brand and retail channels.

organisations.name: Rothkötter Unternehmensgruppe
organisations.why: Large poultry/feed group with seven production sites and strong vertical-chain potential.
organisations.seed_fact: Rothkötter reports around 4,500 employees, seven production sites in northern Germany and about €1.5bn revenue.
organisations.next_action: Resolve farm partnerships, feed mills, slaughter entities, brands, customers, public money and influence.

organisations.name: Sprehe Gruppe
organisations.why: Multi-brand group with contract growers, own slaughter operations and 14 German production sites.
organisations.seed_fact: Sprehe reports eight brands and production at 14 German sites; its Sprehe frisch brand describes contract growers and slaughter in own controlled plants.
organisations.next_action: Resolve the Union-Besitz Holding structure, exact slaughter entities, contract-farm network and brand/product paths.

organisations.name: Arla / former DMK Group
organisations.why: Excellent temporal entity-resolution case: DMK and Arla officially united on 1 June 2026 while DMK GmbH and subsidiaries retain legal status as Arla subsidiaries.
organisations.seed_fact: The merged cooperative reports about 11,200 farmers and 28,800 employees; current structure must distinguish the Arla group identity from continuing DMK legal entities.
organisations.next_action: Build the temporal alias/entity map first, then farms, milk volumes, dairies, brands, public money and lobbying.

organisations.name: Hochwald Foods
organisations.why: Farmer-owned dairy system with direct farm membership, large milk volumes, production sites and consumer brands.
organisations.seed_fact: Hochwald says it processes more than 2bn kg of milk annually and is a cooperative dairy and food group.
organisations.next_action: Resolve current member-farm count, milk flows to specific dairies, brands, animal-welfare programmes, public money and influence.
